svg.title: SPOD-DR framework and joint optimization
svg.desc: SPOD-DR, six queries. Public initialization, 15001 base steps, 1500 readout-only adaptation steps, 4500 joint SAM steps at rho .025. Continuation fixes BN statistics and the backbone prefix. All features, attention and distributions are schematic, not captured model outputs. Thin solid paths show forward computation; dashed paths show training dependencies; thick solid arrows show parameter steps.
